Also note the oxlint design-system-adherence warning: the DC restyles raw HTML with inline styles instead of loading the bound Nocturne bundle via a proper <script src> + window.Nocturne components — per the DC spec inline styles are actually required (class-based CSS isn't allowed in templates), so that warning may be a false positive for this authoring model, but the hang is a real, reproducible blocker and must be fixed before this can ship.
